name: weyland
label: Weyland-Yutani
description: The 2025 look, ported. One cyan on pure black, a warm near-black hairline on every edge, and the copy of a corporate intranet that has been asked to run a film night.

tokens.font-body: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

og_image_alt: Night of a Thousand Pixels 2026, as a Weyland-Yutani screening notice: cyan on black, with the words Building Better Worlds.

copy.site.title: W-Y Screening Programme
copy.site.tagline: Building better worlds. Thirty personnel, two allocations each, one title per cycle, recorded permanently.
copy.quota.barred: Your personnel record carries ranking authorisation only. Requisitions may not be filed against it.
copy.quota.at_limit: All {count} have been expended against this record.
copy.quota.heading: Your allocation
copy.home.lead: Approximately thirty personnel, two allocations each, and a single instant-runoff ballot that determines the evening's programme. Attendance is not mandatory.
copy.home.notice.body: This system is being brought into service for the current cycle. The register opens in early October and the access address is distributed through the usual channel.
copy.home.steps.heading: Programme procedure
copy.home.step1.title: File a requisition
copy.home.step1.body: Early October. Authenticate and enter up to two titles against your personnel record. A trailer reference is optional and materially improves the ranking an entry receives.
copy.home.step2.title: Rank the field
copy.home.step2.body: Enter three preferences in order. The count is instant-runoff, so a second preference is not a discarded vote — it is the one that resolves the round.
copy.home.step3.title: Screening
copy.home.step3.body: The approved title is screened during non-operational hours and entered into the permanent record alongside every prior cycle.
copy.home.archive.heading: Prior cycles
copy.home.archive.empty: No prior cycles are held in this system yet. Earlier records are transferred as they are digitised, and are not removed thereafter.
copy.slate.count.heading: {count} on file
copy.slate.hidden.body: This listing includes withdrawn requisitions, annotated accordingly. Visibility is limited to programme administrators.
copy.slate.empty.heading: No requisitions have been filed
copy.slate.empty.body: Every cycle begins in this state. The register stays open until the closing date, and the first entry filed is customarily the one the rest of the field is ranked against.
copy.slate.actions.signin_note: The register is readable by anyone. Entries may be filed only by personnel assigned to the current cycle.
copy.season.state.draft.label: Not in service
copy.season.state.draft.summary: The current cycle has not been opened. The access address is distributed through the usual channel when it is.
copy.season.state.submitting.label: Register open
copy.season.state.submitting.summary: Requisitions are being accepted. The ballot opens automatically when the register closes.
copy.season.state.voting.label: Ballot open
copy.season.state.voting.summary: The register is closed. Enter three preferences in order — the second preference is the one that resolves the count.
copy.season.state.locked.label: Cycle closed
copy.season.state.locked.summary: This cycle is concluded and held in the permanent record. No further entries are accepted.
copy.outcome.winner.body: {title}. The count is final and has been entered into the permanent record. Personnel whose preferences were not returned are reminded that the ballot was conducted correctly.
copy.outcome.tied.body: The final round of the count returned a level result, so no title carried. Resolution is deferred to the attending personnel.
copy.movie.trailer.title: Reference material: {title}
copy.submit.heading: Requisition form
copy.submit.lead: A title is the only mandatory field. A trailer reference and a one-line justification are optional, and are the parts other personnel actually read before ranking.
copy.submit.existing.heading: {count} filed against this record
copy.submit.errors.heading: {count} to correct before this form can be accepted.
copy.submit.field.title.label: Title
copy.submit.field.title.hint: The name of the picture. This is the one field the system cannot infer.
copy.submit.field.year.label: Year
copy.submit.field.year.hint: Optional, four digits. Recorded to disambiguate remakes, of which there are always several.
copy.submit.field.trailer.label: Trailer reference
copy.submit.field.trailer.hint: Optional. A YouTube address plays in the register; any other address is recorded as a link.
copy.submit.field.description.label: Justification
copy.submit.field.description.hint: Optional, and the only field anybody reads. One accurate sentence outperforms three.
copy.submit.blocked.locked.heading: Cycle closed
copy.submit.blocked.locked.body: {season} is held in the permanent record. Sealed records are not amended, and the register for that cycle stands as filed.
copy.submit.blocked.voting.heading: The register is closed
copy.submit.blocked.voting.body: Requisitions are no longer accepted for this cycle. Every accepted entry is now before the ballot, and the count determines the remainder.
copy.submit.blocked.draft.heading: Not yet in service
copy.submit.blocked.draft.body_dated: The register opens on {date}. The access address is distributed through the usual channel.
copy.submit.blocked.draft.body_undated: Dates for this cycle have not been entered. The access address is distributed once they are.
copy.submit.blocked.barred.heading: Ranking authorisation only
copy.submit.blocked.barred.body: {quota} This is a setting held against your personnel record rather than an allocation you have expended. If it appears to be in error, raise it through the usual channel.
copy.submit.blocked.at_limit.heading: Allocation expended
copy.submit.blocked.at_limit.body_dated: {quota} Both entries are listed below. The ballot opens on {date}, at which point they are assessed by everybody else.
copy.submit.blocked.at_limit.body_undated: {quota} Both entries are listed below. The ballot opens when the register closes, at which point they are assessed by everybody else.
copy.submit.blocked.outsider.heading: Not assigned to this cycle
copy.submit.blocked.outsider.body: The register is readable without authentication and writable only by assigned personnel. If you are on this cycle's list, authenticate with the address held on your record. If you are not, request assignment through the usual channel.
copy.submit.blocked.unknown.heading: Requisition not accepted
copy.submit.blocked.unknown.body: This form is not being accepted against your record at present, and the reason is not one this page is able to report. The register remains readable, and the usual channel is the fastest route to an explanation.
copy.error.404.heading: No record at this address
copy.error.404.body: The address may be superseded, or may refer to a cycle not yet in service. No fault has occurred — there is simply nothing filed here.
copy.error.500.heading: Unhandled fault
copy.error.500.body: The system encountered an error and abandoned this page. The fault has been logged. Retry in one minute, and report it through the usual channel if it persists.
copy.error.405.heading: Method not permitted
copy.error.405.body: The page exists but does not accept requests of the kind received. This ordinarily indicates a stale form or a resubmitted requisition.
